text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of a long and
arduous
journey in the Twinkle Series for
me and my
trainee. Her name is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello there, Trainer dearie. It's me,
Wonder
Acute.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I may not look it, but I'm good and spry,
so don't
you hesitate to train me up
strong.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And we don't need to rush. Let's just
work our way
steadily to our goals, bit
by bit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days challenging the
Twinkle
Series with
<chrname>!
